detail.longDescription: I love Civilization VI, and I've been playing since it came out a little over a decade ago. I decided to vibe code up a clone that can be played in the browser (currently playable up to the industrialization era) I initially reproduced the game mechanics through a combination of memory and online sources, but that misses a huge amount of detail. I took inspiration from another project, civvis.ai. They used actual recordings of the game to get all the mechanics right. I have been dong the same, running through AI games to gather more recordings and make the mechanics more accurate, but there is still a long way to go! (Please let me know if you find inaccuracies) My ultimate goal is to have an accurate recreation of the engine for myself and other hackers to mess around with. Particularly, I've been running AI agents through the game to see how they do, and whether they could make formidable opponents. Please excuse the AI art - I am not an artist. I tried iterating on it a lot, but I could not fully dispose of that tell tale AI texture. Enjoy~
